decision_research.exit_similarity.formul: Exit distance combines 50% market structure, 40% holding state, and 10% Beijing calendar distance. Market structure reuses the three timeframes and four groups; holding state uses actual entry price and frozen entry ATR20. Each market group and the holding-state group require at least 80% comparability. Account pressure is excluded.

decision_research.outcome.detail.summary: {horizon} bars · {metric}; episode-median difference {median}; secondary mean {mean}; paired rank-biserial {rank}; 95% interval {ci}; p={p}; BH q={q}
decision_research.outcome.descriptive_bo: If unmatched sample means are shown, they remain descriptive and never enter paired inference, BH evidence status, or a strategy conclusion.
decision_research.outcome.exit.title: Matched EXIT_NOW/HOLD Outcome Comparison
decision_research.outcome.exit.warning: Results use the next decision-bar open and gross continuation paths, with differences fixed as HOLD minus EXIT_NOW. They do not predict a decline, issue an exit signal, or establish strategy efficacy.
decision_research.outcome.exit.empty: No exit outcome comparison exists for this context. A run retains the complete 5×3 matrix, including items without reliable evidence.
decision_research.outcome.exit.running: Matching cutoff-time market structure and position state before reading outcomes, then running episode-level inference; safe cancellation is available.
decision_research.outcome.exit.detail.pa: Pair EXIT_NOW {exit_now} / HOLD {hold}: HOLD minus EXIT_NOW is {value}
decision_research.outcome.exit.descripti: If unmatched EXIT_NOW/HOLD distributions are shown, they remain descriptive and never enter paired inference, BH evidence status, or an exit conclusion.
decision_research.snapshot.empty_body: Select a valid Setup version and refresh research results to view the dynamic draft. Insufficient evidence and failed experiments remain visible.
decision_research.snapshot.published_hin: New data, labels, or models never overwrite a published version; create a new version when evidence changes.
decision_research.snapshot.draft_require: Generate the current draft before publishing an immutable version.
decision_research.snapshot.draft_unavail: The current draft is not ready yet.
decision_research.snapshot.publish_ready: The draft inputs are frozen; publishing creates a new immutable version.
decision_research.snapshot.new_evidence: New data, labels, or models are available. Published versions stay unchanged; create a new version.
decision_research.snapshot.publish_cance: Research snapshot publication was cancelled; the current draft can be retried.
